item.title: [−1] Brent settles at $109.55, near a five-month high, as Iranian threats offset strong Gulf flows
item.description:
Iraq's oil exports rose above 3.4 million barrels a day in October, but Hormuz tanker traffic fell and Iran threatened wider attacks. Holding near Friday's $109.86 despite the Russia waiver. Ongoing.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Crude-linked inputs

Why it matters: Crude near $110 keeps India's import bill, fuel costs and inflation high and pressures the rupee and reserves.
